priority_item: Clean up debug console statements from frontend code
description: Remove or replace 46 console.log/warn/error debug statements scattered across 15 frontend source files. These debug statements clutter the browser console in production, expose internal implementation details, and can impact performance. Replace with proper error boundaries or remove entirely.
rationale: The report shows 'Frontend failed to start/build' as a runtime error, but investigation reveals the build now succeeds. The actual issue is 46 debug console statements in production code across components like QuestionInput, QABlock, SessionContext, etc. This is the highest-impact, lowest-risk cleanup that improves UX and code quality without requiring schema changes.
acceptance_criteria: All console.log statements used for debugging are removed from frontend/src/**/*.ts(x) files
Error handling console.error statements are either removed or replaced with proper error boundary/reporting
No TypeScript compilation errors after changes
Frontend build completes successfully (npm run build)
Browser console is clean during normal app operation (no debug noise)
